<action type="say">
Got it, we can definitely line up some quotes.

I need a few details first:

1) Address (or at least city + ZIP) where the work will be done?  
2) Timing:  
   - Is this an emergency, same-day if possible, or routine (flexible in next days/weeks)?  
   - Any preferred date(s) and time window (morning/afternoon/evening)?
3) Faucet situation:  
   - Do you already have the new faucet purchased? If yes, what brand/model (or basic description: pull-down sprayer, single-handle, etc.)?  
   - Is this a straight swap in the same location, or any changes (e.g., adding a sprayer, soap dispenser, extra holes)?
4) Sink/ hookups:  
   - Is the existing shutoff working and under-sink plumbing in decent shape (no visible leaks/corrosion), as far as you know?  
   - Is this on a standard kitchen sink (not a special prep/Bar sink in an odd location)?
5) Access/parking issues the plumber should know about (gated building, street parking only, pets, etc.)?

Once you share that, I’ll submit a request to get multiple plumber quotes and then show you the options so you can pick who to book.
</action>
